dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: Being stuck in a place like this is a waste of my youth...

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: Whoa! Wh—Who are you? Sneaking up on me like that... Ahem, it's nothing, I was just talking to myself!

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: Anyway, spending every day stuck in these ruins... If I'm not reciting boring hymns, I'm helping my sister sort through books — books that would take a lifetime to sort! I don't want to waste my youth like this.

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: *sigh* Goodbye. If only I could go adventuring like you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: Me? I want to be an adventurer, of course! Just like those treasure hunters — free and unbound — or the legendary thief, Reed Miller!

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: Exploring unexplored domains, searching for legendary treasures, going on adventures with beautiful, captivating young maidens... That's the life for me!

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: Ehrnrooth. She's the Lady Moonchanter's right-hand woman... Uhm, please don't tell her anything I just said.

dialogues.speaker: Ossian
dialogues.text: If she hears I've been complaining again, I'll be on the receiving end of yet another half-day sermon...
